resources.string: Archived categories disappear from pickers. Transactions that use them keep them.
Uncategorized is where anything without a category goes, so it can\'t be archived.
Tags like \"work\" or \"trip-goa\" group transactions across categories. You\'ll add them while adding transactions.
Merge %1$s into %2$s? Every transaction tagged %1$s will be tagged %2$s instead.

resources.string: An event is a named date range, such as a trip. Every transaction in its dates gets its name as a tag, so the whole trip can be found and totalled.
Another event already has this name
Pick the first and last day
Every transaction on these days is tagged with this name, including SMS that arrive later. Changing the dates or name moves the tag.
The event goes, but transactions already tagged %1$s keep the tag, so the trip\'s history stays.
